why.bring: Only a set encoder has a bring head. wp-v1d is trained on 10x the closed-sheet battles, and passes both regimes.
why.in_battle_open: Passes in_battle_pass (played-out ECE 0.02987, a hair under 0.03). wp-v1d-gbt scores better (0.5415 vs 0.5523) but is set-blind: it gives the same number whatever the opponent is holding, and a set-blind model is not served.
why.in_battle_closed: Passes closed_sheet_pass, decided on 1,088 held-out battles with 99.8% power against logits 1.5x too sharp. wp-v1d-gbt scores better (0.5593 vs 0.5633) and is not served for the same reason: it does not use revealed set information.
